items.statement: Shadow inbox: an agent stages a draft reply for every incoming email before the user opens it.
items.verbatim_anchor: every email arrives with a draft reply already waiting

items.statement: In a hand test, roughly half of the user's pre-drafted replies went out unedited.
items.verbatim_anchor: about half my hand drafted replies went out untouched

items.statement: The shadow inbox safety line: it never sends anything, it only stages drafts.
items.verbatim_anchor: it never sends, it only stages, that is the safety line

items.statement: The user indicated driftless scheduling stays the primary project and shadow inbox goes to the icebox.
items.verbatim_anchor: driftless stays the main bet, shadow inbox goes to the icebox

items.statement: The user recognized they chase shiny new ideas exactly when the current one gets hard.
items.verbatim_anchor: I reach for shiny new ideas exactly when the current one gets hard

items.statement: A weekly digest of auto-archived threads could build trust in the shadow inbox.
items.verbatim_anchor: a weekly digest of what it auto archived would build trust

items.statement: The user will write a one-page icebox memo for the shadow inbox idea.
items.verbatim_anchor: one page icebox memo so future me can pick it back up

items.statement: The user receives about one hundred forty real emails a week excluding newsletters.
items.verbatim_anchor: about a hundred and forty real emails a week once you strip newsletters

distractors.anchor: my standing desk squeaks every time I lean in
